# Prize Category Justification

## Best Use of TabPFN ($200 partner category) — PRIMARY claim

**What the category asks for:** use TabPFN to forecast, predict, classify, or spot anomalies from historical data, ideally inside a wider prediction agent, and show a clear improvement over a baseline.

**What we use.** TabPFN (Prior Labs open-weight tabular foundation model) is the core predictor for every verdict. It does in-context learning: a small hand-labelled corpus plus a new 10-feature repo vector, one forward pass, a posterior over six death modes.

**Where in the code.**
- `app/classifier.py` — TabPFN load + in-context classification, 10-feature vector, posterior over `abandoned / burned_out / pivoted / completed / alive / insufficient_history`.
- `app/main.py` — wires the classifier into the autopsy flow; engine label (`classified by TabPFN` / `tabpfn + llm · adjudicated` / `rules`) rendered from the real engine field.
- `scripts/eval_loo.py` — the held-out evaluation.

**Inside a wider prediction system (what the category favours).** TabPFN is the engine; around it: GitHub feature extraction feeds it, an open-weight LLM (deepseek-v4.1-flash on 0G Compute) adjudicates its closest two-way calls on a high-confidence read, and a grounding gate (`app/narrator.py`) guards the generated eulogy against the real evidence.

**Improvement over a baseline (measured, held-out).** Leave-one-out cross validation over 117 hand-labelled repos:
- TabPFN: 58.1%
- 1-nearest-neighbour baseline (same features): 43.6%
- +14.5 points, vs a ~21% chance rate across five populated classes.
Honest note: one feature (`primary_language_freq`) is full-corpus encoded; it is symmetric (both models get it) and conservative (removing it raises the 1-NN baseline to 45.3%, so it does not inflate TabPFN's win).

**Integration depth:** core. Remove TabPFN and the product has no verdict, only a transparent rules fallback (labelled as such).

## Main track — Ghost in the Machine (open-source AI at its core)

**Open-weight end to end.** TabPFN (local, the verdict) + deepseek-v4.1-flash via 0G Compute (the reading and the voice). Both are open-weight; every verdict comes from inspectable weights.
- TabPFN runs locally: `app/classifier.py`.
- 0G Compute narration/adjudication: `app/main.py` (`prov = "0G Compute"`), `app/narrator.py`.

**Theme:** Día de los Muertos reading — remember the dead by name, with a cause of death the tool can defend. Honest-by-design: the grounding gate refuses ungrounded eulogies (`tests/test_narration_grounding.py`).

## Honest notes
- No smart contracts, no on-chain component. This is an open-weight AI + web project, so contract-track claims are N/A.
- 0G Compute is a network call (not local) for narration; the live service is open-weight end to end but not fully offline. Stated plainly in the post and the honesty ledger.
